verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS PR-review and product-workflow tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted deployment of the core product. The materials describe a hosted service: Foreloop serves the widget, and the CLI, npm package and MCP are clients of that service rather than a way to run it yourself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
